integrity: A self-contained all-n proof and reproducible finite checker are supplied. No formal verification, external assessment, or independent validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Only two distinct-letter permutations differing by a one-step cyclic shift are classified.
The number of full-length minimal common supersequences is not given in closed form.
Finite checker tests n=2,...,8 only; the infinite claim rests on the argument.
Full 1996 algorithmic article inaccessible; earlier equivalent special-case work remains possible.
title: A three-point length spectrum for minimal supersequences of cyclically shifted permutations
